description: Wall-clock budget for BenchmarkSuite.run_all() in CI. Prevents the suite from growing so slow that CI integration becomes impractical as per-region benchmarks are added.
network: 700-neuron small network (same env overrides as ci_performance_baseline.json)
note: To recapture the baseline after an intentional change: run BenchmarkSuite.run_all() with ci_params on the small network and update measured_baseline_s. Do NOT widen budget_s to paper over a slow regression.
